K.q huq` vs. FormFactor/Basic.lean:145-147 `isometry := Bilin.reflect_isometry g hSymm u hu / fixes_left := Bilin.reflect_apply_of_orthogonal g u p hup / fixes_right := ... u p' hup'`.
findings.fix: Factor the shared notion once in `Bilin` (Tensors/Basic.lean, next to `IsIsometry`/`reflect`): `structure Bilin.IsStabilizer (g : Bilin V) (a b : V) (f : V →ₗ[ℝ] V) : Prop where isometry : IsIsometry g f; fixes_left : f a = a; fixes_right : f b = b`, with `Bilin.reflect_isStabilizer` carrying the common proof. Then define `Hadronic.IsKinematicStabilizer g K f := Bilin.IsStabilizer g K.p K.q f` (updating its uses at Tensors/Basic.lean:535, 539, 546, 571, 863, 1140, 1168, and deleting `reflect_isKinematicStabilizer` in favour of the shared lemma), and in this file use `Bilin.IsStabilizer g p p'` instead of a new structure, deleting `IsElasticStabilizer` and `reflect_isElasticStabilizer`.
findings.issue: `IsElasticStabilizer` (lines 109-115) and `reflect_isElasticStabilizer` (142-147) are a clone of `Tensors.Hadronic.IsKinematicStabilizer` (Tensors/Basic.lean:523-530) and `reflect_isKinematicStabilizer` (Tensors/Basic.lean:569-574): the same three fields (`isometry : Bilin.IsIsometry g f` plus two `f _ = _`), and the reflection lemma's proof is character-for-character the same three terms. The predicates are logically the same notion (the file's own docstring at line 107 notes fixing `p, p'` equals fixing `p, p'-p`); only the carrier of the two fixed vectors differs (a `DisKinematics` record vs. a bare pair).

findings.evidence: Tensors/Basic.lean:853-858 `span : ∀ v, ∃ a b u, g K.q u = 0 ∧ g (pTransverse g K) u = 0 ∧ v = a • pTransverse g K + b • K.q + u` and `definite : ... → u ≠ 0 → g u u < 0`; FormFactor/Basic.lean:167-169 `span : ∀ v, ∃ a b u, g u p = 0 ∧ g u p' = 0 ∧ v = a • p + b • p' + u` and `anisotropic : ... → u ≠ 0 → g u u ≠ 0`.
findings.fix: Parameterize one structure over two vectors beside `Bilin.IsStabilizer` — e.g. `Bilin.IsPlaneSplitting g a b` with the `span` and `anisotropic` fields — and have `Hadronic.SpectatorAssumptions` extend it with only the extra strengthening it needs (`definite`, `transitive`), stating its `span` in the `(p, q)` basis; `ElasticSpectatorAssumptions` then disappears in favour of `Bilin.IsPlaneSplitting g p p'`, and `elasticSpectatorAssumptions_pWit` instantiates the shared structure.
findings.issue: `ElasticSpectatorAssumptions` (165-169) is a second, parallel bundle for the same geometric content as `Hadronic.SpectatorAssumptions` (Tensors/Basic.lean:850-863): `span` splits every vector into the {two-momentum} plane plus a `{p,p'}^⊥` spectator, which is the same plane and the same orthogonal complement as the existing `span` written in the `(p_T, q)` basis (`p_T = p - (p·q/q²) q`, so `span{p_T,q} = span{p,q} = span{p,p'}` for `p' = p + q`), and `anisotropic` is the existing `definite` with `< 0` weakened to `≠ 0`. Two structures now assert span-plus-non-degeneracy of the same subspace under two names.

summary: The module reuses Bilin.reflect, gWit and Mathlib derivative/limit API correctly, but IsElasticStabilizer and reflect_isElasticStabilizer are a field-for-field, proof-identical clone of Hadronic.IsKinematicStabilizer and reflect_isKinematicStabilizer, and ElasticSpectatorAssumptions restates the same {p,q}^⊥ span/non-degeneracy content as Hadronic.SpectatorAssumptions. Both should be factored into one shared two-vector predicate in the Bilin namespace.
